events.summary: HR-40110 (BLDC motor, China origin, listed under the 850131 rule at 25%, effective 1 November): net duty to act on is 139,714 USD, which is the duty on the 12-month requirement not yet covered by open supply (3,656 EA at the reference price of 152.86 USD). Gross is 226,752 USD on every open line and the full forecast. Halden is importer of record on all three open lines (HPO-26-00450/10, HPO-26-00614/10, HPO-26-00614/20), so Halden pays the duty; the Incoterm was not returned, so the terms should be confirmed before entry.

HR-40110 at 1,000 pieces, per piece, known parts only: Shenzhen Yunzhan Precision Motor's quote Q-YZ-26-0831 lands at 188.99 USD (151.19 price plus 37.80 duty at 25% on China origin, FOB Shenzhen, 35 days after receipt of order, Net 60), against 191.08 USD on Halden's last PO (152.86 price plus 38.22 duty, incoterm blank). That quote is valid until 13 October, 18 days left as of the 25 September data date, and it excludes Section 301 duty, which stays with the buyer, and a re-quote if the magnet index moves more than 10%. Vinh Phuc Motor Technology's quote VPM-Q-260924 shows 160.87 USD with origin unknown (Vietnam claimed, magnets from China, documents on request, sender not in the supplier master, 200-piece MOQ, FOB Hai Phong, 60 days after PPAP, 30% deposit); it is 201.09 USD if ruled China origin, so it is only cheaper if a customs broker confirms non-China origin. Still unknown for all three: freight and insurance (Dana), the broker's origin ruling for Vinh Phuc, and the incoterm on Halden's last PO.

args.subject: HR-40110 BLDC motor: certificate of origin, HTS code and ship dates for open lines
args.body:
Hello,

We are preparing for the new duty on China-origin BLDC motors that starts on 1 November. For part HR-40110 (Motor, BLDC, 48 V 400 W, 86 mm frame, hall sensors), please send:

1. The certificate of origin, or other proof of origin, for HR-40110.
2. The HTS classification you use for HR-40110. Our records show 8501314000, so please confirm it or correct it.
3. The ship date for each open line, and the date each will enter the destination port, given your force majeure notice of 22 September:
 - HPO-26-00450 line 10, 355 EA, promised 26 August
 - HPO-26-00614 line 10, 435 EA, promised 23 September
 - HPO-26-00614 line 20, 350 EA, promised 26 October

Please also confirm the Incoterm on these lines. We need the answers by 15 October, so please reply as soon as you can.

This request does not change any term of the orders and does not waive any of Halden's rights.

Thank you,
Halden Robotics Procurement

recommendation.finding: The new 25% duty on the China-origin drive motor (HR-40110) starts 1 November. Halden is importer of record on all three open lines, so $140K is owed on the 12-month requirement that open supply does not cover. A further $43K falls due only if the open orders ship late. All 1,140 EA on open orders sit under Yunzhan's 22 September force majeure, so their dates do not hold. I've drafted a request to Yunzhan for origin papers, ship dates and the Incoterm, and it waits for approval. Yunzhan's quote lands at $188.99 against $191.08 on the last PO. Vinh Phuc's $160.87 is only cheaper if a customs broker confirms non-China origin, and it is $201.09 if ruled China.
